_readme: Google review snapshot. Update these values from the live Google Business listing, then run: node src/build.mjs. Only add reviews that appear on the listing, copied exactly. Show reviewer names as initials only. 'time' is the relative time as supplied. 'stars' null = star rating not supplied (the card shows a 'to be confirmed' label instead of stars). 'initials' null = not supplied.

breakdown._note: Rating and total supplied by the client: verify against the live Google listing before publishing. STAR BREAKDOWN TO BE CONFIRMED: null = not entered (bar stays empty and shows a dash).

_mapNote: Google Maps place links cannot be shown inside an iframe, so the map uses Google's embed form of the same place (name + coordinates 16.7554642, 81.6845425 from the supplied link). Verify the pin against the clinic address before publishing.

reviews.text: I visited the dental clinic and the doctor nithasha mam is very kind and their treatment was so good and painless treatment in this clinic 🤍 …
I went there for my mother's root canal & cap for crown. The service is best. I highly recommend people to go there

I recently visited Mullapudi dental clinic for treatment of root canal, dental cleaning and cap for my crown. From the moment I walked in, the team made me feel at ease. Dr. Nithisha Maam was gentle, explained each step, and ensured I felt no pain during the procedure. The clinic was clean and well-organized, and the equipment looked modern. I’m really happy with my smile. I appreciate their professionalism and personal care. I’ll definitely return for future check-ups!
